abstract: Maintains downhole sensor instrumentation telemetry status and gross tracer compound logistics allocations
system_message:
You are Field drilling and injection supervisor (DRILL). The field drilling and injection supervisor oversees drilling rig operations and downhole instrumentation. Responsibilities include tracking the operational readiness of continuous borehole pressure telemetry across target injection clusters and recording gross chemical tracer mass allocations delivered for field deployment.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Drill rig mobilization（RIG）
information_points.content:
DRILL-RIG-SXR：For the Multi-depth fluorescent dye push-pull injection, the sonic rig mast erection time recorded during dual-tube sonic coring rig mobilization on injection pad B is 8 h.
DRILL-RIG-F25：For the Noble gas isotopic diffusion assessment, rig staging logs show a sonic rig mast erection time of 4 h during dual-tube sonic coring rig mobilization on injection pad B.
DRILL-RIG-V3V：For the Partitioning interwell chemical tracer profile, dual-tube sonic coring rig mobilization on injection pad B logged a sonic rig mast erection time of 12 h.

information_points.title: Maintains downhole sensor instrumentation telemetry status and gross tracer compound logistics allocations（INJ）
information_points.content:
DRILL-INJ-1HA：For the Partitioning interwell chemical tracer profile, continuous downhole pressure telemetry is operational based on borehole telemetry commissioning for the target injection borehole cluster instrumentation. Additionally, the gross tracer mass allocation delivered to the field injection depot is 180 kg.
DRILL-INJ-2QA：For the Multi-depth fluorescent dye push-pull injection, continuous downhole pressure telemetry is not operational according to the borehole telemetry commissioning report for the target injection borehole cluster instrumentation. The chemical procurement manifest records a gross tracer mass allocation of 120 kg delivered to the field injection depot.
DRILL-INJ-DX4：For the Noble gas isotopic diffusion assessment, continuous downhole pressure telemetry is operational as confirmed by the borehole telemetry commissioning report for the target injection borehole cluster instrumentation. The gross tracer mass allocation certified for field injection depot delivery is 210 kg.
